_meta.description: Translator-context sidecar for auth.workspaces. Workspace-selection grid.
_meta.audience: Authenticated users who belong to one or more workspaces.

selector.ownerBadge: Pill rendered on a workspace card when the current user has the workspace_owner role. Keep ≤ 6 chars after translation.
selector.activeLabel: Static caption shown beneath each workspace name; visual cue only.
selector.loadingDefault: Generic loading copy used when no specific phase is in progress.
selector.loadingWorkspaces: Shown while the workspace list is being fetched.
selector.loadingSelecting: Shown while a workspace selection is in flight (overlay).
